landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.q1: What is a digital stamp card?
landing.faq.a1: It replaces the paper card. Customers keep it in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet and collect stamps at every visit.
landing.faq.q2: How is Biome different from other providers?
landing.faq.a2: You get a finished card, the stand and full setup instead of just software. We stay available for changes.
landing.faq.q3: How does the digital stamp card work?
landing.faq.a3: A guest scans your QR code once and saves the card. You add a stamp at each visit and the reward unlocks automatically.
landing.faq.q4: What do I have to do myself?
landing.faq.a4: Send us your logo and the reward. We build the card, the sign-up page and the dashboard for you.
landing.faq.q5: What does a digital stamp card cost?
landing.faq.a5: 29 euros a month with everything included. The first 30 days are free and there is no setup fee.
landing.faq.q6: Is it worth it for a small shop?
landing.faq.a6: Yes. One extra regular a month usually covers the price. You also see who comes back.
landing.faq.q7: Do my customers need an app?
landing.faq.a7: No. The card lives in the wallet already on every modern phone.
landing.faq.q8: Does it work with iPhone and Android?
landing.faq.a8: Yes, with Apple Wallet on iPhone and Google Wallet on Android.
landing.faq.a9: Usually a few minutes for you. We take care of the rest within a day.
landing.faq.q10: How does a customer get a stamp?
landing.faq.a10: Your team stamps in the staff view or by scanning the card. It takes a second.
landing.faq.a11: Cafés, restaurants, bakeries, barbers, beauty studios and any shop with regulars.
landing.faq.q12: Can I send messages to my customers?
landing.faq.a12: Yes. Send offers to everyone who has your card, as often as you like.
landing.faq.a13: Yes. We host in Europe and only store what is needed for the card.
landing.faq.q14: Can I cancel at any time?
landing.faq.a14: Yes, monthly and without a notice period.
